newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Marsford can resume AQC buy - ASC.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Marsford can resume AQC buy - ASC.

text.p: The Australian Securities Commission said on Tuesday it had agreed to dissolve a court order preventing Marsford Investments Pte Ltd from acquiring more shares in takeover target Allied Queensland Coalfields Ltd.
The corporate regulator said in a statement that the new Federal Court ruling took effect at the close of Tuesday trade.
It had sought the injunctions obtained last Friday which prevented further share purchases by Marsford, a unit of Hong Kong's Consolidated Electric Power Asia Ltd.
The ASC action was based on a belief that Marsford was entitled to a previously-undisclosed 8.9 percent of AQC.
Marsford denied that it was entitled to those shares, the ASC said, and the temporary order that this holding not be dealt would continue while further inquiries were made.
Marsford has bid 78 cents per share for AQC, three cents a share higher than a rival offer for the Brisbane-based steaming coal miner by Centennial Coal Co Ltd.
The largest shareholder in Allied Queensland is Crusader Ltd, a unit of Clyde Petroleum Plc, which has a controlling 43.4 percent holding.
Crusader plans to sell to Marsford offer in the absence of a higher bid. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
